name: The Daily Bagel
note: Newsprint broadsheet — the menu as classifieds.
thesis: A small-town broadsheet front page for a bagel truck: aged newsprint cream, near-black ink, one firebrick spot color, Georgia serif headlines at weight 900, two-column justified-feeling body with a drop cap, dotted price leaders, and a rule hierarchy (3px / 2px / 1px) doing all the structure. The menu is the classifieds, the owners are the feature, the schedule is the almanac, and the item detail is the Fancy Modal restyled into a right-side paper sheet — the 'full column'.

tokens.bg: #F1EFE6 aged newsprint cream everywhere — page, drawer, art plates (#E9E6DA base under the etchings); the single inversion is the #141414 'Add to order' bar
tokens.fg: #141414 ink; body copy #4A4A44; secondary chrome #3A3A3A; captions/hints #5A5A5A; faint labels and allergens #7A7568
tokens.accent: #B22222 firebrick — kickers, prices, the Order Ahead nav item, the drawer price, hover reds; always ink-on-paper, never a fill (the sole fill use is the add-bar hover)
tokens.fontDisplay: literal Georgia / 'Times New Roman' serif stack set on the root; display is just this serif at weight 900 and scale (74px nameplate, 52px lead headline, tight -0.02em tracking)
tokens.fontMono: not used — the second voice is var(--font-sans) for UI chrome (dateline nav, kickers, captions, prices, tags, buttons); the serif/sans split IS the type system
tokens.radius: 0 everywhere — rows, chips, buttons, the drawer are square-cornered; the single exception is the 50% round white drawer close button
tokens.border: #141414 rules in three weights: 3px (masthead top, schedule close), 2px (nav underline, catering box, quote button, drawer art rule), 1px (section hairlines, art frames); #C8C4B8 soft in-column dividers; 1px dotted #8A8578 price leaders
tokens.motion: none — no keyframes or transitions; hover is an instant #E8E5DA background swap on menu rows and the drawer snaps in and out on state change, like turning a page

layout: Single centered 1120px column with 34px side padding, stacked as full-width newspaper sections separated by horizontal rules of varying weight. Masthead: dateline row, 74px weight-900 nameplate between a 3px top rule and 1px bottom rule, letterspaced sans tagline, then a centered sans nav under a 2px rule. Lead story is a 2fr/1fr grid — red kicker, 52px headline, column-count:2 body with a 58px ::first-letter drop cap, etched hero plate with a FIG. 1 caption on the right. The menu is a 2-column grid of tappable Cards (88x74 thumb, weight-900 name, dotted leader stretching to a red sans price, one-line description). The story section mirrors the lead as 1fr/2fr. The schedule is a Fancy Table of six day/place rows on #C8C4B8 hairlines, closed by a 3px rule. A 2px ink-outlined WANTED classified carries the catering CTA, then a hairline-topped sans footer. Selecting any menu item opens the Fancy Modal restyled as a fixed 520px right-side paper sheet (flat rgba-ink scrim, -20px ink shadow); the primitive owns Escape, scroll-lock, focus trap, and stacking.

sections.name: masthead
sections.what: Newspaper masthead: a Vol. I / Milwaukee / Est. 2026 · 50¢ dateline, the 'The Daily Bagel' nameplate (a Link back to the collection hub) bracketed by the 3px/1px rules, a 0.24em-tracked sans tagline, and a centered sans nav under a 2px rule — 'Order Ahead' is the only red item and opens the best seller's full column.
sections.restyle: Hand-rolled type and rules — the three-rule hierarchy is the signature device and has no primitive equivalent. The nav is plain anchors to section ids; the one action, 'Order Ahead', is a restyled Fancy Button (variant="ghost") flattened to a red inline link that opens the best seller's full column. Navbar is deliberately skipped here: its fixed brand/items justify-between wrapper (no centering hook) and its items hiding below md would fight the centered newspaper section bar and drop the anchors on mobile.

sections.name: lead story
sections.what: 2fr/1fr front page: red sans kicker 'Front Page · Boiled & Baked Daily', a clamp()'d 52px weight-900 headline, body copy in CSS column-count:2 with a floated drop cap R, and an etched 'this morning's dozen' SVG plate with an underlined FIG. 1 caption.
sections.restyle: Pure CSS typesetting: columns via column-count, the drop cap via ::first-letter float. The photo is replaced by an ink-etched SVG tray of twelve bagels (shared <symbol> sprite) washed with the site-wide grayscale(1) contrast(1.12) filter so it reads as a halftone press photo.

sections.name: menu classifieds
sections.what: A centered '— THE MENU —' banner between hairline rules with a 'tap any item for the full column' hint, then a 2-column grid of six clickable rows: bordered 88x74 etched thumbnail, weight-900 name, a dotted leader line stretching to a red sans price, and a one-line description. Rows hover-swap to #E8E5DA and open the drawer.
sections.restyle: Each of the six rows is a Fancy Card (variant="flat", padding="none") repainted transparent with radius 0 and a single #C8C4B8 hairline underline; the whole card is the click target (role="button" + tabIndex + Enter/Space handler + aria-haspopup="dialog") that opens the full-column Modal. Inside: a bordered 88x74 etched thumbnail, a weight-900 name, a flex:1 dotted price leader (border-bottom:1px dotted #8A8578, nudged translateY(-4px) — the classic menu-card device) stretching to a red sans price, and a one-line description. Thumbnails alternate two etching variants deterministically, mirroring the mockup's imgId logic.

sections.name: our story
sections.what: Mirrored 1fr/2fr feature: etched single-bagel plate left, 32px weight-900 headline 'Two Owners, One Kettle, Zero Days Off (Almost)', and two-column body about Rosa (Brooklyn boiler, two-day cold ferment, malt in the boil, 'a bagel is 90% patience') and Sal (the deli window man).
sections.restyle: Same column-count:2 treatment as the lead; the grid mirror keeps the broadsheet rhythm. The pull-quote stays inline in prose — newsprint doesn't break out a quote card.

sections.name: week listings
sections.what: Centered all-caps 'WHERE TO FIND THE TRUCK THIS WEEK', then a 3-column grid of six Mon–Sat day/place rows, each a baseline-aligned flex row with a #C8C4B8 bottom rule, the whole section closed by a 3px ink rule.
sections.restyle: Rendered through a Fancy Table (Table.Body / Row / Cell) flattened to a transparent newspaper almanac: the primitive's outer frame, rounded corners, and divide-y are all reset, leaving #C8C4B8 hairline row rules, a bold-serif day lead column, and a muted right-aligned place column. Closed by the section's 3px ink rule.

sections.name: catering classified
sections.what: A 2px ink-outlined box styled as a WANTED classified: red 'Classified · Catering' kicker, weight-900 headline, a support line nodding to the Human+ assistant ('Our assistant will build the order — just say the word'), and a 'Get a quote →' outline Button that swaps the copy to a confirmation on click.
sections.restyle: Button flattened to the classified voice: transparent, 2px ink border, radius 0, 13px bold sans, inverting to ink fill on hover. The quoted state is one useState boolean — the ad rewrites its own support line, aria-live polite.

sections.name: footer + folio
sections.what: Hairline-topped sans footer: bold brand, scrape-obfuscated email (the @ split into a nested span) plus the social handle, and the 'Printed with love' copyright; below, a soft-ruled uppercase folio line with the style number and a firebrick back-link to the collection.
sections.restyle: Small sans utility voice throughout; the back-link is the only navigation the page adds — no fixed headers or back bars that would fight the gallery frame.

sections.name: item drawer (the full column)
sections.what: Selecting a row renders a fixed full-screen scrim (rgba(20,20,20,0.5)) with a 520px right-side drawer in the same paper: 250px etched plate over a 2px rule with a round white close Button, red 'The Menu · Full Column' kicker, 34px name + 24px red price, square tag Badges, the long copy, 'Built with' ingredient Badges, an allergens line, and a full-width inverted ink 'Add to order · $price' Button that flips to a confirmation once clicked.
sections.restyle: Backed by the Fancy Modal primitive, restyled from its centered rounded-white default into the newsprint drawer: the panel is pinned position:fixed to the right edge (520px, max-width 94vw, full height), square-cornered, repainted #F1EFE6 with a -20px ink shadow, and the primitive's blurred scrim is recolored to a flat rgba(20,20,20,0.5) via a :has() hook on the panel. The Modal owns Escape, scroll-lock, focus trap, and stacking — no hand-rolled overlay or page z-index remains. It portals to <body>, so the drawer subtree re-declares the newsprint tokens under .mpbagels-drawer. Inside: a 250px etched plate over a 2px rule with a circle Button close, a red 'Full Column' kicker, 34px name + 24px red price, square ink tag Badges, the long copy, #C8C4B8-bordered 'Built with' ingredient Badges, an allergens line, and the full-width inverted-ink 'Add to order' Button (the page's only inverted block).

palette.restyle: The six tappable classified menu rows. variant="flat" padding="none" repainted transparent (bg-white / flat fill / rounded-lg all reset), radius 0, one #C8C4B8 hairline underline, #E8E5DA hover swap. The whole Card is the click target — role="button" + tabIndex=0 + Enter/Space handler + aria-haspopup="dialog" — opening the full-column Modal. Holds the 88x74 etched thumbnail, weight-900 name, dotted price leader, red price, and one-line description.

The Mon–Sat week listings (Table.Body / Row / Cell, no head). Flattened to a transparent newspaper almanac: outer frame, rounded corners, and divide-y reset; #C8C4B8 hairline row rules, transparent cells with zero side padding, a 120px bold-serif day lead column, and a muted #4A4A44 right-aligned place column. A listings block, not a data grid.

The item-detail 'full column'. Restyled from the primitive's centered rounded-white card into a right-side paper sheet: panel pinned position:fixed to the right edge (520px, max-width 94vw, full height, display:block, overflow-y auto), square corners, repainted #F1EFE6 with a -20px ink shadow; the blurred scrim recolored to flat rgba(20,20,20,0.5) via a :has() hook. The Modal owns Escape, scroll-lock, focus trap, and stacking (no page z-index). It portals to <body>, so the drawer subtree re-declares the newsprint tokens under .mpbagels-drawer.

Four reads: (1) variant="ghost" 'Order Ahead' in the masthead nav — flattened to a red inline link matching the anchors; (2) the classified 'Get a quote' — transparent, 2px ink border, radius 0, 13px bold sans, ink-fill on hover; (3) variant="circle" drawer close — a 34px white disc, the lone rounded element; (4) the drawer 'Add to order · $x' — full-width inverted #141414 bar with paper text, firebrick on hover, the page's only inversion.

Squared to 1px classification stamps, never pills (all inside the drawer, scoped under .mpbagels-drawer): variant="outline" with an ink border + 11px bold sans for item tags (Staff pick / Vegetarian / Best seller), and a softer #C8C4B8 border with 13px regular sans in #4A4A44 for 'Built with' ingredient chips.

Deliberately NOT used — the display type is bespoke newsprint typesetting the primitives can't carry: raw h1/h2 inherit the root Georgia stack at weight 900 with -0.02em tracking, and raw

bodies at 15px/1.6 pour into column-count:2 blocks with a 58px ::first-letter drop cap. Reach for Heading/Text only outside these hand-set columns.

Deliberately NOT used for the masthead — its brand/items justify-between wrapper has no centering hook and its items hide below md, both of which would break the centered newspaper section bar. The nav stays plain section-anchor <a>s with the one action ('Order Ahead') as a restyled ghost Button. If you do reach for Navbar in this look, flatten items to the sans utility voice (12px uppercase, 0.08em tracking, #3A3A3A on paper over a 2px ink rule) and reserve firebrick for the single action.

contentArchetype: A fictional Milwaukee family food truck (Mom-n-Pops — Rosa & Sal, est. 2026) selling bagels, written entirely as fake newspaper journalism: dateline and nameplate, a kettle-boiled-bagels lead story with 'sources close to the truck', the six-item menu priced as classifieds, an owners feature with an inline pull-quote, a Mon–Sat street-corner almanac, a WANTED catering classified that name-checks the ordering assistant, an obfuscated-email footer, and a per-item 'full column' drawer with tags, ingredients, allergens, and an add-to-order bar.
remix: Swap the firebrick for any ink-safe spot color (forest, navy, oxblood) and the cream for a cooler gray-white to reskin the whole paper. The load-bearing moves: (1) the 3px/2px/1px ink-rule hierarchy replacing every box and shadow, (2) weight-900 serif display against a sans utility chrome, (3) dotted price leaders on flex rows, (4) column-count:2 body with a ::first-letter drop cap, (5) grayscale(1) contrast(1.12) over all art so anything — SVG etching or real photo — reads as halftone press imagery. Blend toward FIELDWORK's editorial style by adding mono folios and softening the rules to hairlines; push tabloid by inflating the nameplate, tightening leading, and letting headlines shout in all caps; go full deli-counter by trading the drawer for an inline ticket rail while keeping the classified rows.
